description: A ball-and-stick model of a water molecule (H₂O). Two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom represented as spheres with appropriate element colors (oxygen in red, hydrogens in white), connected by stick-shaped bonds. The sticks must visually connect to the surfaces of the atom balls.
